findings.value: A renovated Victorian warehouse in Shoreditch, set under railway arches and topped with graffiti-covered tube carriages. Time Out counts it among London's most atmospheric places for gigs and clubs.

evidence.quote: Set underneath some cavernous railway arches
four brightly coloured, graffiti-covered tube carriages perched on its roof
one of the city’s most atmospheric gig and club venues
the renovated Victorian warehouse space inside
which often hosts top electronic DJs and exciting up-and-coming artists

findings.value: Gigs and club nights most nights of the week, often with top electronic DJs and up-and-coming artists.

evidence.quote: Most nights of the week you can catch an artist or DJ on the cusp of huge things
which often hosts top electronic DJs and exciting up-and-coming artists

notes: Refresh of an existing profile. Time Out (datePublished 2025-07-16) and the venue's About page (modified 2023-10-02) were read in full. One WebSearch found no closing, renaming or reopening news; it returned a trade article on a licence renewal (egi.co.uk), which was not read and is not news of a closure. The venue's own FAQ and access pages were not re-read this run, so the existing profile's quotes from them are unchanged.
